tokens.strategy: normative semantic roles; no duplicated primitive values

native.accessibilityLayout: compact navigation and stacked reader header
native.typography: Relatively scaled system serif and sans; reference CSS line heights are not measured native metrics.
native.chrome: Native tab bars, sidebars, grouped forms, sheets, keyboard/focus and safe areas.

extensions.referenceKind: Design renderings; synthetic reference text never replaces full catalog content.

verification.scope: Phone/tablet/light/dark/AX/forms/launch; scoped visual acceptance, not release or publication approval.

extensions.motion: Reference guidance only; native transitions and system Reduce Motion govern implementation.
